snippet.title: [STORYG] Medi-Cooker :: New Trailer
snippet.description:
Medi-Cooker launches on August 8th at 6PM KST

You wake up in a forest with no memories. Gather ingredients, craft special potions, and help the dolls with troubles to uncover hidden secrets. Medi-Cooker is a story-driven 2D platformer adventure where you explore a Storybook-Like World, converse with dolls, and unravel the mysteries within.

Add it to your wishlist on Steam or STOVE Indie, and be ready to play the moment it launches!
